caption: Amalfi Cathedral, Amalfi
composition: Striped Duomo façade above the coastal town · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The striped marble Duomo fills the right of the frame, its grand staircase climbing to the glowing arched portals with the campanile rising behind.
